name: Hex-Rays IDA MCP
description_en: Official Hex-Rays MCP server for agent access to IDA databases, with headless operation and optional GUI integration.
description_zh: Hex-Rays 官方 MCP 服务，让 agent 操作 IDA 数据库，支持无界面分析和可选 GUI 联动。
requirements: IDA 9.4+ with idalib, Python 3.11+, Git and uv; the GUI plugin is optional for headless use.

name: GhidraMCP
description_en: Ghidra extension and MCP bridge exposing decompilation, symbol navigation and renaming to agents, with GUI and headless modes.
description_zh: 通过 Ghidra 扩展和 MCP 桥接提供反编译、符号导航与重命名，支持 GUI 和无界面运行。
requirements: Match the extension to the documented Ghidra release; Python 3.10+ for the bridge, with additional PyGhidra requirements for headless mode.

name: Binary Ninja MCP (official)
description_en: Binary Ninja's own MCP interface exposes functions, symbols, disassembly, intermediate languages and decompiled text to agents.
description_zh: Binary Ninja 自带的 MCP 接口向 agent 提供函数、符号、反汇编、中间语言和反编译文本。
requirements: Reviewed in the development manual: use a build containing MCP. GUI server uses HTTP; headless stdio requires Commercial or Ultimate on macOS/Linux.

name: Binary Ninja MCP (fosdickio)
description_en: Community Binary Ninja plugin and bridge for MCP clients, including workflows that switch among multiple open binaries.
description_zh: 社区维护的 Binary Ninja 插件与 MCP 桥接，支持在多个已打开的二进制目标间切换。
requirements: Binary Ninja, Python 3.12+ and an MCP client; install the plugin separately from the client bridge.

name: IDA Pro MCP (mrexodia)
description_en: Community IDA integration useful for existing setups and migration context; its maintainer now recommends the official Hex-Rays MCP server.
description_zh: 已有工作流可参考的社区 IDA 集成；维护者目前推荐迁移到 Hex-Rays 官方 MCP 服务。
requirements: IDA Pro rather than IDA Free, Python 3.11+ and an MCP client; consult the upstream migration notice before choosing a new setup.

name: Radare2 MCP Server
description_en: Native radare2 MCP server offering binary-analysis tools, reusable sessions and configurable read-only access.
description_zh: 基于 radare2 原生接口的 MCP 服务，提供二进制分析、会话复用和可配置的只读访问。
requirements: A compatible radare2 build and r2pm, plus an MCP client; advanced HTTP session features depend on the radare2 ABI.

name: r2ai
description_en: AI plugins inside radare2 for function explanations, naming suggestions and model-assisted decompilation using local or remote models.
description_zh: 在 radare2 内使用本地或远程模型，辅助解释函数、改善命名和反编译结果。
requirements: radare2 with the matching r2ai/decai plugins; configure a local model or the credentials required by the selected remote provider.

name: DAILA
description_en: Decompiler-independent AI assistant for function summaries and naming across IDA, Ghidra, Binary Ninja and angr-management.
description_zh: 跨 IDA、Ghidra、Binary Ninja 与 angr-management 的 AI 助手，用于函数摘要和命名辅助。
requirements: A supported decompiler and dailalib; configure a model backend. Ghidra requires the documented PyGhidra setup.

name: RevEng.AI Ghidra Plugin
description_en: Connects Ghidra to RevEng.AI for function similarity, recovered names, AI explanations and agent-assisted annotation.
description_zh: 将 Ghidra 接入 RevEng.AI，用于函数相似性匹配、名称恢复、AI 解释及辅助标注。
requirements: A compatible Ghidra/Java build and a RevEng.AI API key; creating service-side analysis uploads the selected binary.

name: JADX-AI-MCP
description_en: JADX plugin paired with a Python MCP server to inspect decompiled Android classes, resources, cross-references and debugger context.
description_zh: 结合 JADX 插件与 Python MCP 服务，读取 Android 反编译代码、资源、交叉引用和调试上下文。
requirements: JADX with the plugin and the separate JADX MCP Server component; upstream lists Java 11+ and Python 3.10+.

name: frida-mcp (yfe404)
description_en: Frida MCP server with persistent instrumentation sessions, runtime inspection and Android static-to-dynamic navigation.
description_zh: Frida MCP 服务，提供持久插桩会话、运行时检查和 Android 静态代码与动态现场之间的导航。
requirements: Node.js 20+, Frida 17 and an accessible target; on-device operations require the documented device/frida-server setup.

name: Super Trouper
description_en: Single-binary Frida MCP server for discovering devices, managing process sessions and loading instrumentation scripts.
description_zh: 单个可执行文件形式的 Frida MCP 服务，用于发现设备、管理进程会话和加载插桩脚本。
requirements: Published host binaries target macOS/Linux; target connectivity must support Frida. Source builds need Go, CGO and a matching Frida Core DevKit.

name: LLDB MCP
description_en: LLDB's official MCP interface gives agents debugger sessions and commands for breakpoints, memory inspection and stepping.
description_zh: LLDB 官方 MCP 接口提供调试会话与命令，使 agent 可以设置断点、检查内存和单步执行。
requirements: An LLDB distribution/build containing lldb-mcp and a compatible stdio MCP client; debug-target access follows the host platform's requirements.

name: Claude Reverse Engineering Skill
description_en: Community agent skill for triage, headless exports and evidence-based RE reports; explicitly documents workflows with REA and other MCP servers.
description_zh: 社区 agent skill，覆盖分诊、无界面导出和证据报告，并明确说明 REA 及其他 MCP 服务的工作流。
requirements: An Agent Skills-compatible client and Python 3.8+ for bundled scripts; analysis engines and MCP servers are configured separately.

name: SpecterOps Reverse Engineering Skills
description_en: Focused Binary Ninja and Ghidra analysis skills that describe MCP tool use, analysis recipes and annotation practices.
description_zh: 针对 Binary Ninja 与 Ghidra 的分析 skills，提供 MCP 工具使用、分析步骤和标注方法。
requirements: Configure the chosen Binary Ninja or Ghidra MCP integration separately; the skill package does not install or wrap those servers.

name: Ghidra
description_en: Open-source analysis suite for disassembly, decompilation, graphs and Java/Python automation across executable formats.
description_zh: 开源二进制分析套件，提供反汇编、反编译、图形分析及 Java/Python 自动化接口。
requirements: An official Ghidra release and its required JDK; extension and script compatibility must match the installed release.

name: radare2
description_en: Scriptable command-line framework for inspecting, disassembling, debugging and modifying binaries across many architectures.
description_zh: 可脚本化的命令行逆向框架，支持多架构二进制检查、反汇编、调试和修改。
requirements: Use the release/build for your host; decompilers and other optional functionality may require separate plugins.

name: Cutter
description_en: Rizin-powered graphical reverse-engineering workspace with extensible views and Ghidra decompiler integration.
description_zh: 基于 Rizin 的图形逆向工作台，提供可扩展视图及 Ghidra 反编译器集成。
requirements: Desktop builds are available for Linux, macOS and Windows; use plugins compatible with the selected Cutter release.

name: Frida
description_en: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for observing and scripting the behavior of live native and managed processes.
description_zh: 动态插桩工具，用脚本观察和分析运行中的原生及托管进程行为。
requirements: Host bindings or CLI tools and a supported target setup; mobile/server/Gadget and signing requirements vary by platform.

name: JADX
description_en: Dex-to-Java decompiler with CLI/GUI navigation, resource decoding and cross-reference search for Android packages.
description_zh: 将 Dex 反编译为 Java 的 CLI/GUI 工具，提供 Android 资源解码、代码导航和引用搜索。
requirements: 64-bit Java 11+ unless using a bundled runtime; decompilation can be incomplete and should be checked against bytecode.

name: Apktool
description_en: Decodes Android resources and smali into a project-like tree and can rebuild modified packages.
description_zh: 将 Android 资源与 smali 解码为项目目录，并支持重新构建修改后的安装包。
requirements: A supported Java runtime and the release-specific launcher; rebuilding is distinct from recovering original Java source.

name: Androguard
description_en: Python toolkit for APK/DEX metadata, bytecode and reference analysis; the v5 source branch also documents agent skills and MCP.
description_zh: 用于 APK/DEX 元数据、字节码及引用分析的 Python 工具集；v5 源码分支还提供 agent skills 和 MCP 文档。
requirements: Version-sensitive: the reviewed README distinguishes the v5 source tree from PyPI 4.1.4; v5 extras require additional Rust/Python components.

name: ILSpy
description_en: .NET assembly browser and C# decompiler with whole-project export, metadata inspection and a scriptable command-line frontend.
description_zh: .NET 程序集浏览器与 C# 反编译器，支持完整项目导出、元数据检查和命令行处理。
requirements: Choose a desktop or ILSpyCmd release and its matching .NET runtime; frontend and operating-system support are release-dependent.

name: dnSpyEx
description_en: Community continuation of dnSpy for debugging and editing .NET assemblies without the original source.
description_zh: dnSpy 的社区延续项目，可在没有原始源码时调试和编辑 .NET 程序集。
requirements: Windows desktop workflow; Unity debugging requires the companion runtime setup documented by the project.

name: @electron/asar
description_en: Electron's archive tool lists and extracts ASAR contents so packaged JavaScript and application assets can be inspected.
description_zh: Electron 官方归档工具，可列出和提取 ASAR 内容，便于检查打包后的 JavaScript 与应用资源。
requirements: The reviewed release requires Node.js 22.12+; extraction reveals archive contents, not missing source maps or original source names.

name: webcrack
description_en: Improves JavaScript readability by reversing supported obfuscation patterns and unpacking webpack/Browserify bundles.
description_zh: 识别支持的 JavaScript 混淆模式，并拆解 webpack/Browserify bundle，改善代码可读性。
requirements: The reviewed README specifies Node.js 22 or 24; results depend on the obfuscator/bundler patterns present in the input.

name: WABT
description_en: WebAssembly tools for binary-to-text conversion, section inspection, validation, interpretation and C translation.
description_zh: WebAssembly 二进制与文本转换、节区检查、验证、解释执行及 C 转换工具集。
requirements: Select a release supporting the module's WebAssembly features; optional proposals may require explicit flags.

name: wasm-tools
description_en: Bytecode Alliance CLI and Rust libraries for inspecting WebAssembly modules, metadata, components and WIT interfaces.
description_zh: Bytecode Alliance 提供的 CLI 与 Rust 库，用于检查 WebAssembly 模块、元数据、组件和 WIT 接口。
requirements: Use prebuilt release artifacts or a Rust toolchain; proposal/component support depends on the selected release.

name: Binwalk
description_en: Identifies embedded formats and optionally extracts their contents, with entropy analysis for firmware triage.
description_zh: 识别固件中的嵌入格式并按需提取内容，辅以熵分析帮助初步分诊。
requirements: The current v3 implementation is Rust-based; extraction needs the appropriate external tools or the documented container environment.

name: unblob
description_en: Recursively extracts archives and filesystems from binary blobs while reporting chunk boundaries and unknown regions.
description_zh: 递归提取二进制数据中的归档与文件系统，同时报告数据块边界和未识别区域。
requirements: Python package plus external extractors, or the bundled Docker image; check the project's dependency inventory for the formats needed.

name: Ghidra Firmware Utilities
description_en: Ghidra loaders and helpers for PCI option ROMs, UEFI firmware volumes, Intel flash descriptors and coreboot images.
description_zh: 面向 PCI Option ROM、UEFI 固件卷、Intel Flash Descriptor 和 coreboot 镜像的 Ghidra 加载器与辅助脚本。
requirements: The reviewed build instructions require Ghidra 12.0+ and JDK 21+; build against the same Ghidra/JRE environment used for analysis.

name: Qiling
description_en: Python emulation framework that adds OS, filesystem and API behavior around CPU emulation for instrumented binary analysis.
description_zh: 在 CPU 仿真之上补充操作系统、文件系统和 API 行为的 Python 框架，用于可插桩的二进制分析。
requirements: A supported Python environment and the target's required root filesystem/libraries; emulation coverage varies by platform.

name: Unicorn Engine
description_en: Multi-architecture CPU emulator for executing selected instruction ranges with register, memory and hook control.
description_zh: 多架构 CPU 仿真引擎，可控制寄存器、内存和 hook，执行选定的指令片段。
requirements: Use a supported binding and explicitly supply the CPU state and memory model; it is a CPU emulator rather than a complete OS environment.

name: angr
description_en: Python binary-analysis framework combining control-flow recovery, symbolic execution, data-flow analysis and decompilation.
description_zh: 结合控制流恢复、符号执行、数据流分析和反编译的 Python 二进制分析框架。
requirements: A compatible Python 3 environment; useful results require an appropriate model of program inputs, state and external functions.

name: LIEF
description_en: Library for structured parsing and modification of executable formats including ELF, PE and Mach-O.
description_zh: 对 ELF、PE、Mach-O 等可执行文件格式进行结构化解析与修改的库。
requirements: C++, Python or Rust integration; check the distinction between core and extended features for the selected distribution.

name: Capstone
description_en: Disassembly library with architecture-neutral APIs and instruction details for custom binary-analysis pipelines.
description_zh: 提供统一 API 和指令细节的多架构反汇编库，适合构建自定义二进制分析流程。
requirements: Select a library/binding release supporting the target ISA and mode; the next branch can differ from stable releases.

name: ImHex
description_en: Hex editor with a binary-pattern language, structured data inspection and visual tools for understanding file formats.
description_zh: 带二进制模式语言、结构化数据检查及可视化功能的十六进制编辑器，适合理解文件格式。
requirements: Desktop build or web edition; some data sources and features depend on the platform and selected build.

name: x64dbg
description_en: Windows binary debugger with disassembly, memory views and plugins for analyzing programs without source code.
description_zh: Windows 二进制调试器，通过反汇编、内存视图和插件分析没有源码的程序。
requirements: Windows; choose x32dbg or x64dbg according to the executable's architecture.

name: GDB
description_en: Native and remote debugger for controlling execution and inspecting live or crashed program state.
description_zh: 支持本地与远程调试，可控制执行并检查运行中或崩溃后的程序状态。
requirements: A GDB build supporting the target architecture and a permitted local process, core dump, simulator or remote debug endpoint.

name: rr
description_en: Records process execution and replays it under GDB, enabling repeatable inspection and reverse execution.
description_zh: 记录进程执行并在 GDB 下重放，便于重复检查现场和反向执行。
requirements: Linux with supported CPU performance counters; VM use depends on counter virtualization and the project's hardware requirements.

name: Diaphora
description_en: IDA-based binary diffing that matches functions and transfers names, comments and types between analyzed versions.
description_zh: 基于 IDA 的二进制差异分析工具，可匹配函数并迁移名称、注释与类型信息。
requirements: IDA with Python 3 support; richer pseudocode and microcode comparisons depend on the corresponding decompiler capabilities.

name: BinDiff
description_en: Compares disassembled binaries to find matching functions and changed code across versions.
description_zh: 比较反汇编后的二进制文件，定位不同版本中的对应函数与代码变化。
requirements: Requires a separate supported disassembler/export pipeline; upstream documents IDA Pro, Binary Ninja and Ghidra configurations.

name: Detect It Easy
description_en: Format-aware file identification and static inspection using parsers, signatures and programmable heuristics.
description_zh: 结合格式解析器、签名和可编程启发式规则进行文件识别与静态检查。
requirements: Use the project-linked DIE-engine releases for the host platform; identification results require analyst interpretation.

name: OpenSecurityTraining2
description_en: Free self-paced security courses with learning paths for reverse engineering, firmware and systems foundations.
description_zh: 免费的自主学习课程，提供逆向工程、固件和系统基础等学习路线。
requirements: Browser access; choose classes according to their published prerequisites and lab requirements.

name: pwn.college: Reverse Engineering
description_en: Hands-on reverse-engineering module covering functions, data access, static tools and dynamic tools with hosted exercises.
description_zh: 包含托管练习的逆向工程课程，覆盖函数、数据访问、静态工具和动态工具。
requirements: Browser access and the platform's account/environment setup for interactive challenges.

name: Reverse Engineering for Beginners
description_en: Dennis Yurichev's free book on understanding compiled programs and assembly, available in multiple languages.
description_zh: Dennis Yurichev 编写的免费逆向入门书，以汇编与编译后程序理解为核心，提供多语言版本。
requirements: A browser or PDF reader; use the toolchains relevant to the exercises being followed.

name: The Official Radare2 Book
description_en: Official practical reference for radare2 analysis, disassembly, scripting, debugging and related plugins.
description_zh: radare2 官方实践参考，覆盖分析、反汇编、脚本、调试及相关插件。
requirements: Upstream lists radare2 5.8.x as the minimum and recommends a current release for following the examples.

name: RenderDoc
description_en: Inspect frame captures, draw calls, shaders, and graphics resources in your own game or graphics application.
description_zh: 检查自己游戏或图形应用的帧捕获、绘制调用、着色器和图形资源。
requirements: Supported graphics API and replay platform; upstream supports captures of your own, open-source, or free projects. Metal is not supported.

name: AssetRipper
description_en: Analyze Unity game files, inspect asset dependencies, and convert supported assets into Unity project formats.
description_zh: 分析 Unity 游戏文件，检查资源依赖并将支持的资源转换为 Unity 工程格式。
requirements: Unity 3.5.0–6000.4.X coverage varies by version; GPL-3.0 open-source edition, with separate premium features.

name: Cpp2IL
description_en: Recover managed representations from Unity IL2CPP builds using binary and metadata analysis; reconstruction remains a work in progress.
description_zh: 结合二进制与元数据分析，从 Unity IL2CPP 构建恢复托管表示；重建能力仍在开发中。
requirements: Compatible Unity build and metadata; current development branch is a major rewrite and primarily targets .NET 9.0.

name: Il2CppDumper
description_en: Recover IL2CPP metadata and dummy assemblies, and generate helper scripts for native analysis tools; method code is not restored.
description_zh: 恢复 IL2CPP 元数据及占位程序集，为原生分析工具生成辅助脚本；不会还原方法代码。
requirements: Matching IL2CPP executable and global-metadata.dat; documented Unity support is 5.3–2022.2.

name: RenderDoc MCP
description_en: Expose existing RenderDoc captures to an agent for bounded frame, pipeline, resource, and shader inspection.
description_zh: 向 Agent 开放已有 RenderDoc 捕获文件，分步检查帧、管线、资源和着色器。
requirements: Windows and replayable .rdc capture; maintainer baseline is RenderDoc 1.43. Optional native Python backend needs a source-built binding.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description_en: Connect an agent to Chrome for live page inspection, network debugging, and performance traces.
description_zh: 连接 Agent 与 Chrome，检查实时页面、调试网络并记录性能轨迹。
requirements: Supported Node.js LTS, Chrome, and an MCP client; selected browser profile and target must be available locally.

name: mitmproxy
description_en: Inspect and record HTTP traffic with an interactive proxy, web interface, or scriptable command-line tools.
description_zh: 通过交互代理、Web 界面或可脚本化命令行检查和记录 HTTP 流量。
requirements: Configure the client proxy; HTTPS inspection requires the appropriate local trust configuration. Saved captures and live interception are distinct workflows.

name: Playwright MCP
description_en: Drive browser interactions through structured accessibility snapshots to investigate reproducible web behavior.
description_zh: 通过结构化无障碍快照驱动浏览器交互，调查可复现的网页行为。
requirements: Node.js 18+ and an MCP client; the upstream also offers a separate CLI-and-skills approach for coding agents.
